text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's face contorts as the
lambs
surround her. As for how we got
here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega and I were headed back to
the
academy when...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing really...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Curren sent me another animal video...
and
something in it surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Next stop, Meadowside Farm Station.

Meadowside Farm Station.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than surprised, she seems more
cheerful
watching the video on her
phone. Visiting a farm
might be a nice
idea to brighten her mood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait...
choice_data_list: Want to go see some animals?
Want to go see some animals?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As it turns out, the farm is holding an
event where
you can pet the lambs,
which brings us to where
we are now.

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, wait. Why are they all coming
this way?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ack... Why me?
choice_data_list: Maybe it just wants to be petted?

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaa... Baaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, yeah... Rub your head on me all
you
want, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine, I'll pet you just a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's... so warm.)

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaaa... Baaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? You too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This one feels quite different from the
last one...
It feels like...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This little guy is so skinny.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's because of a nutrient
deficiency?
Or maybe stress? Whatever
the reason, their
wool...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell a farm worker what Admire Vega
had said.
choice_data_list: I'll go ask someone at the ranch.

text_block_list.name: Farm Worker
text_block_list.text:
You're right. They only just arrived
recently, so it
might be stress caused by
the move. I bet they
haven't been
sleeping well...

text_block_list.name: Farm Worker
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting us know! It's really
good you
noticed so quickly!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was just a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It certainly wasn't a big deal...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It certainly wasn't a big deal...
choice_data_list: It did help the little lamb.
It was for the little lamb's good, at least.
Could we apply this to other things?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: It did help the little lamb.
It was for the little lamb's good, at least.
Could we apply this to other things?

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I guess that's good.

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaa, baaa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That little one won't stop bleating at
me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you saying "thank you"?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heh... Of course not...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There's no way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day in the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boof!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Are you okay?! I must have
tripped...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The texture of Hayahide's hair just
now...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide... are you getting enough
sleep?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! How... Actually, I did have trouble
falling
asleep last night.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But does it really show on my face? I
appreciate
the heads up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not your face, it's...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Never mind. Just take care of
yourself.
